news.title: 6 更多魔法：我们想要的超越宇宙中的聚会交叉
news.summary: With MTG’s Universes Beyond lineup expanding, here are 7 more ideal fantasy and sci-fi crossovers we want to s

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/7-more-mtg-crossover-ideas-ign-1787588324845.png

Not too long ago, we put together a wishlist of seven Magic: The Gathering crossovers we'd love to see in Universes Beyond ( whether that's in 2027 or in the next few years). Well, I've been thinking about it again, and, frankly, there are still far too many great possibilities out there to stop at seven.

With Magic's Universes Beyond lineup continuing to expand, I've decided to throw six more potential crossovers into the ring. Some are obvious, some are perhaps a little more out there, but all of them feel like they'd fit surprisingly well into Magic's increasingly expansive multiverse.
As we covered in that original wishlist, we know Magic has three more Universes Beyond sets lined up for 2027, arriving in April, August, and November.
Hasbro CEO Chris Cocks has also suggested that next year's crossovers will be "a bit more fantasy-adjacent", following feedback from fans on some of the more recent collaborations.

That still leaves a huge amount of room for speculation, and more than enough fantasy worlds we'd love to see collide with Magic. So, here's our sequel: six more Universes Beyond crossovers we'd love to see.
The Elder Scrolls

Starting things off, The Elder Scrolls. While we are still painstakingly awaiting The Elder Scrolls VI , an eventual crossover with Magic: The Gathering wouldn't be beyond the realms of imagination, especially if we're talking epic fantasy.
Bethesda has already partnered with Magic as part of the Universes Beyond: Fallout set, so extending that partnership to Bethesda's other gaming titan... It just works.

Honestly, I probably should have included this in the original article. I can absolutely see this happening in the near future. Whether that's in 2027, or whenever The Elder Scrolls VI eventually releases in the (fingers crossed) next few years.
Supernatural

Okay, admittedly, this is one of my more "out there" picks for a Magic: The Gathering crossover. It's absolutely fantasy-adjacent, but its 21st-century setting may put off more than a few diehard Magic fans. Still, I'm going to die on this hill, because I genuinely think Supernatural could make for a fantastic Universes Beyond set.

The show's mythology almost already feels tailor-made. Magic has Angels and Demons as established creature types, while the show's spells, rituals, curses and supernatural artefacts could slot neatly into the game's existing card types. Then you've got 15 seasons of monsters, supernatural creatures and a ridiclously extensive cast of characters to draw from. It pretty much sorts itself at this rate.

Plus, Universes Beyond has already shown that Magic can accommodate worlds that look and feel very different from its traditional fantasy settings. If anything, the show's grimy Americana, roadside diners, abandoned churches, forests and endless motel rooms could give the set a visual identity unlike anything else in Magic.

Beyond all that, Supernatural was an absolutely massive part of the TV landscape for years, and the nostalgia for it is very real. A set like this would be tapping into a fanbase that grew up with Sam and Dean, making it a potentially huge nostalgia play for both Supernatural fans and new Magic players.
The Chronicles Of Narnia

If Wizards of the Coast really is looking to lean further into fantasy with its next Universes Beyond sets, then The Chronicles of Narnia feels like an obvious contender. It's difficult to think of many properties that fit Magic's traditional fantasy aesthetic quite as naturally, with talking animals, witches, kings, mythical creatures and epic battles all baked into the world of Narnia.

There's also a huge amount of material to work with across the seven books, from Aslan, the Pevensie siblings and the White Witch to Mr. Tumnus, Caspian, Reepicheep and the countless creatures of Narnia. And while the books are decades old , the movies from the 2000s mean there's a hefty dose of nostalgia here too. Plus, there's that Greta Gerwig adaptation upcoming in 2027 as well.

Narnia feels like exactly the kind of crossover that could appeal to both longtime Magic players and a whole new audience, while being one of the easiest Universes Beyond properties to slot into Magic's fantasy world.
Buffy the Vampire Slayer

If we're talking about properties that could tap into a serious well of nostalgia, Buffy the Vampire Slayer feels like another strong contender. Like Supernatural, it's a modern setting that might seem a little strange alongside Magic's traditional fantasy worlds, but the actual subject matter fits surprisingly well... again!

Vampires, demons, witches, werewolves, ghosts and a whole host of other supernatural nasties would give Wizards plenty to work with. Albeit, again, similarly to Supernatural, so I wouldn't expect to see both in Universes Beyond.
Brandon Sanderson's Cosmere Universe

Brandon Sanderson’s Cosmere Universe feel tailor-made for Universes Beyond. Sanderson has previously said that WotC reached out for a potential partnership, but progress stalled a couple of years ago due to other projects taking priority.
Whether split into distinct Mistborn and Stormlight Archive Commander decks within a complete set, or launched as a full tentpole release for each series, this feels like a match made in heaven.
Because Sanderson is an outspoken MTG player , who has previously written official lore for Wizards of the Coast , the connection goes far deeper than basic brand synergy as well.
So, this seems like another sure bet to me, if both parties can get things up and running again.
The Wheel of Time

If Wizards really does want to lean into more fantasy-adjacent Universes Beyond sets, Robert Jordan's sprawling fantasy world seems almost tailor-made for Magic. Somehow I'm also mentioning Brandon Sanderson again as well, who famously stepped in to bring Jordan's masterwork across the finish line .

The Wheel of Time gives you an enormous amount of material to work with, so this seems like an easy fit, whether that's in 2027, or beyond that. And with the recent Amazon series introducing the world to a new generation of fans, the timing feels pretty good too. If only they hadn't cancelled it, it was getting really good!
Those are our new predictions/ additions to the wistlist, but what are you expecting from Universes Beyond in the coming years? Let us know in the comments!

Robert Anderson is a Senior Commerce Editor for IGN. Based in London, UK, he is a qualified journalist with a First Class degree in BA Journalism and over seven years of professional writing and editing experience. You can usually find him lost in open-world RPG games like Elden Ring and Cyberpunk 2077 , or tinkering in Planet Coaster and Two Point Museum. Outside of gaming, he enjoys reading comics (especially Superman, Batman, and Spider-Man), taking photos, and keeping up with the latest in film and TV.

news.title: GTA 6 扩展版的 99 个细节
news.summary: Love Fist, gameplay, and other Vice City memories. Here are 99 new details we spotted in the GTA 6 Extended Lo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-breakdown-aug-blog-1787918107578.jpg

We just got our clearest and most extensive look at GTA 6 yet, and there’s obviously plenty to unpack. From our first glimpses of gameplay to new characters and story insights, we’ve combed through every frame to pick out the things that matter most. There’s a lot to get through, so let’s not waste any more time. Here are 99 new details from the GTA 6 Extended Look.

1. Let’s start with the most important thing. Love Fist are back. Well, in the form of a shirt a woman is wearing towards the very end of the extended look, at least. Will we hear Jezz Torrent and the Scottish metal icons back on the radio? Who knows? But it’s good to see someone keeping the Vice City rock scene alive.
Gameplay
2. Moving on, yes, you can pet the dog, but you can also scold or study them, with GTA 6 bringing over Red Dead Redemption 2’s animal collection system.

3. Small actions like this all appear connected to GTA 6’s new criminal profile system, with the simple act of petting the dog accompanied by the appearance of an “angel” icon and a pleasant chime sound, an indicator Jason’s profile has been positively impacted. What we have is something that appears to be similar to Red Dead Redemption 2’s Honor system: do good (or bad) things and be shaped by those choices.

4. Bad things naturally include shooting people in the face. The new purple meter below the health bar marked with an eye icon, along with the healthy amount of slow-mo we saw in the extended look, shows us GTA 6 has been injected with its own version of Red Dead’s Dead Eye system – though GTA fans will recall Michael also had a slow-motion combat ability in GTA 5.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-6-official-extended-gameplay-25-21-screenshot-1787919214484.png

5. During the extended look’s final firefight, this focus ability slows down time and highlights the most efficient parts of an enemy for Jason to target; red for kill points, and yellow disarming ones.

6. There’s loads of stuff in Jason and Lucia’s fridge, and several of the items have icons that denote they can refill your characters’ gauges in some capacity, including the eye icon for the slow-mo, and a bolt, which may well relate to stamina.
7. Jason later eats from a bag of chips and regains health, like how Arthur eats in Red Dead Redemption 2 to boost his HP.
8. Talking of RDR2, it appears that particularly impressive headshots will also be highlighted in a fashion inspired by Rockstar’s western, with cinematic angles activated at specific moments.

9. During the initial drug lab bust sequence, a man is slammed through a wall, suggesting a certain level of destructibility may have been baked into some of the environments, though it’s not clear how dynamic this will be overall.

10. One of the coolest aspects of the newly-revamped gunplay is seen when Lucia reloads a shotgun one-handed while carrying a bag. Having separate reload animations for when a character is encumbered is pretty damn neat.
11. Lucia also seems deadly without a gun in either hand. We see her boxing training in action during a melee encounter, which lends her a very agile combat style.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-6-official-extended-gameplay-9-6-screenshot-1787919270230.png
12. Jason and Lucia can be seen robbing both a waffle house and a food mart. These are examples of smaller robberies you can do for quick cash grabs.

13. It also seems like the characters will conceal weapons behind themselves before busting a robbery, but it’s hard to say whether this is something to be activated or something that happens automatically when being observed by bystanders.
14. While robbing a jewelry store, a civilian attempts to stop Lucia by grabbing her weapon, suggesting NPCs may be less passive when witnessing your crimes and attempt to play the hero.

15. It’s taken a long time, but finally Rockstar has added a comma when writing out thousands of dollars in a GTA game. Related, there are two money indicators on the HUD - presumably, this shows how much money you are carrying on your person, and how much is in your bank account.
16. After dropping down to five in GTA 5, the wanted level is now back to being six stars in GTA 6, as was previously tradition.

17. The new wanted system also includes some additional symbols, displayed below the stars. They detail how much information the police have about you, such as if you’ve been spotted on CCTV, the clothes you are wearing, and if the police have a description of you. There are also icons that show whether you were seen as a couple, whether the police know what vehicle you’re driving, and another symbol featuring a weapon icon – presumably this means the police know to expect armed resistance.

18. The wanted stars can shift from white to red, indicating some kind of a different state of being wanted. The colour change in this extended look comes after a line of police dialogue noting they no longer have eyes on the suspect’s vehicle, suggesting it’s related to the fact you remain wanted, but aren’t actively being pursued at that moment.
19. There’s also a moment where the stars are neither whiter or red, but “hollow” – this indicates that the police do not have a description of you, but do know to respond to a crime.
20. The car icon on the wanted HUD disappears when Jason and Lucia switch from a car to a van, and the police pass close by without noticing their presence.

21. Before jumping in the van, Lucia torches the car they had been spotted in. It’s not clear whether burning the car has a gameplay utility associated with the wanted system, or is just a nice, thematic moment.

22. Putting on masks to rob a store can prevent some of the wanted symbols from appearing, and controlling the flow of incriminating data to the authorities is going to be key to managing your wanted level.

23. A revamped Item wheel allows you to select “Face Wrap” under the “Masks” category, with icons appearing elsewhere on the wheel for hats, outfits, and eyewear, and four other slots. Plus, on the bottom left, there are two icons for consumable healing items.

24. Masks aside, your escape vehicle being reported may mean you need to find a new one. Stealing cars has been totally overhauled in GTA 6, though. For instance, we know a new, tiered system applies to fancier vehicles that may need a key cloner to get into. Older cars, however, just require a slim jim to break into. Back in GTA 5, characters would occasionally use one as part of the breaking-in animation, but in GTA 6 a QTE is needed to successfully push the slim jim in and jimmy the lock. (The on-screen prompt also notes you can smash the window for a sloppier steal.)
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-6-official-extended-gameplay-6-5-screenshot-1787919315370.png
25. Player switching appears very quick in GTA 6, as opposed to the Google Maps-esque zooming in and out from GTA 5.

26. What does resemble Google Maps, though, is the new minimap, which has a snazzy 3D view with buildings clearly visible along the streets. It may well have more polygons than the entirety of Vice City. We haven’t counted, obviously.

27. The character-switching HUD features two portraits of Jason and Lucia, side by side, with a couple of extra details: each has a horned emoji face, and a heart icon links the two portraits. The devil emojis could suggest both have a criminal profile alignment leaning “evil”, and the heart could indicate a romantic bond?

https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-6-official-extended-gameplay-10-51-screenshot-1787919581703.png
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-6-official-extended-gameplay-3-37-screenshot-1787919697327.png

news.title: Rockstar 必须“小心”GTA 6 选择讽刺的内容，因为“非常具体的政治问题或模因很快就会过时”
news.summary: So no Skibidi Toilet? Got it.

content.v: The veil between satire and reality has seemed so thin for such a long time now that I find myself double checking every other news post I see just to make sure it's not something from The Onion—sadly it never is. But I guess it could be worse, I could be the one who has to write the satire, I could be the one who has to write scripts for GTA 6 .

It's certainly a tall order, especially right now, but if someone's able to do it I'm confident in Rockstar, who should be able to pull off some meta-commentary about the make-believe state of Leonida, based on Florida, and the US at large.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/G4f2zTefXPF8tS4yaTLqWf.jpg

"That’s a question a lot of people ask: how do you deal with satire in today’s world?" Rockstar North's co-studio head, Ron Nelson, tells IGN . "I think there’s always stuff to satirize. As long as humans are humans, other humans will figure out ways to satirize what we do."

Sure, they'll always be people who will satirize the world around them, but the key here is doing it well enough that it doesn't make players' eyes permanently roll into the back of their heads, while also holding up against the test of time. Rockstar surely wants people to play and enjoy GTA 6 beyond 2026.

"We have to be careful that what we’re choosing to satirize is not going to feel dated in a weird way," Nelson explains. "I think those broader things are OK to satirize, but very specific political issues or memes will date fast. Even the way our characters speak, we think about it a lot so that they're not using extremely contemporary slang. Even though our characters are a certain age, they need to feel somewhat timeless."
That probably means we won't be seeing any brainrot or references to the orange man in GTA 6, and you know what? Thank god—sometimes art doesn't need to fully imitate life.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA.jpg

content.v: 【机事本】是机核文章区的栏目，每周五更新。每周五下班之前，我们会收集几位编辑的“小作文”，题材随意，立意自选，栏目名取自Windows系统自带的最轻便的文本编辑器，代表“轻便与畅快”
本周出场人物：柏亚舟 白广大 引擎
柏亚舟：巴别塔
科隆的展前发布会上，主持人Geoff不免感慨，我们正处在一个艰难的阶段，游戏行业面临裁员浪潮，游戏玩家要应对硬件普遍涨价，但依然有这么多的开发者，他们依然在持续创造茫茫多优秀作品，然后来到这里相聚。
https://image.gcores.com/e4fa97e9385ff6d6629967cf5f9a9dd0-1440-1080.jpg
其实Geoff说得还不够大，我们甚至可以说，世间纷纷扰扰，只有游戏在让我们团结。这几天的Koelnmesse，几乎就是一座具象的巴别塔，两年前我就有过这样的感受，今年的感受更加明显。
也许原因之一就是中国游戏又变多了，根据不完全统计，这次来了72家中国游戏公司，这还没有算上投资关系，我老是说自己不喜欢国产游戏目前面对的「超级红利」和「超级黑利」现象，总说所有游戏都要统一标准、要好玩，但真正看到同胞们的「超级展台」有来自世界各地的玩家大排长龙，内心没有多余的情感也是不可能的。
除了多，这次来的国产游戏类型也全。在展期发布会，前面几个游戏播片之后，我和翟睿甚至发出了「前面有几个非国产」的感慨，我原本有点担心偏见的存在，但打开科隆官方的油管频道，下面的评论提及的都是游戏本身，而非国籍，偶尔能看见一些质疑，但点赞数还不如「Bring Valko Back」的情愿多。
也感谢AI，实时交流的提速，在这次展会上感受非常明显。在to b展台这边，人们的交流比以往还要热烈，还要人满为患，处处可见小圆桌，以及小圆桌周围认真的讨论；to c展台这边，陌生人因为cos服装、因为熟悉道具打招呼，成了真正意义上的「游戏拉近你我」。
我就遇到了一个背着两米长金箍棒的老哥，一开始还不是很确定是金箍棒，直到我发现倒着的篆体「棒」和「箍」两个字，我说嘿你喜欢《黑神话：悟空》吗，他说当然！于是就有了这张合影。
https://image.gcores.com/70f5a75915781b0bb185ba768dcb2239-1080-1440.jpg
一代一代的人都想修巴别塔，但在绝大多数年代，隔阂、误解乃至冲突才是主流。游戏本无意背负这些，但游戏又创造了一种可能。
白广大：G-Buddy 和 GTA6
首先推荐一位机组的新朋友。
之前我vibe过一个机组日历的小功能，但后来发现对服务器严重不友好，就下架了。现在我们机组用户自己做的这个小机器人有了“那年今日”的全部功能，而且进入页面还可以把它当做一个普通的AI来使用，有一些我们机核自己的熟梗在里面。在此感谢这位创造了G-Buddy的机核用户！
另外说一下今天早上醒来就看见了GTA6 从网线里伸出来的铁拳，看了最新的26分钟演示片，实在是有点按捺不住了，人类游戏工业顶级的“提升密度”的奇观，或许空前绝后。
但是这里又涉及到另一个事情，就是PS5 Pro的涨价曲线。
https://image.gcores.com/e5f0acbd0f24843b185e75a06e44bfe3-1280-960.png

索尼首席执行官户冢弘树对PlayStation主机成本上涨并不特别担忧。在接受《华尔街日报》最新采访时，他表示内存短缺来得正是时候。在PS5经历数次涨价后，该公司计划将重心放在PS Plus订阅用户身上，而非硬件营销。4月份的最新一轮PS5涨价将光盘版的建议零售价从600美元上调至650美元。与此同时，数字版的售价从500美元涨至600美元，而PS5 Pro的售价也从750美元涨至900美元。 该制造商将人工智能数据中心的扩张与存储和内存成本上涨联系在一起。
当前在小黄鱼上的基础价格为：
https://image.gcores.com/13aa0b9eaaebf2a7637f7408909ac58d-1080-2147.jpg
可谓强而有力，简称强力。而在Rockstar 方面来看，《GTA 6》首发不登陆PC平台的原因是：“如果先做PC版本，主机版本就很容易烂尾”。
John Ricchio在播客KIWI TALKZ中表示：Rockstar并非"不在乎PC玩家"，而是基于游戏开发流程的技术考量，Rockstar早期的游戏开发多采用PC优先策略，团队会在性能最强大的PC硬件上进行开发，最后再将成品缩减并移植至规格较低的家用主机。然而这种做法往往导致开发尾声阶段，团队必须耗费大量精力在性能有限的主机上进行移植优化，甚至因此造成糟糕的主机移植品质。
https://image.gcores.com/05be24a892f0730eb85416b2a4e7f038-1280-720.png
好好好。
然而，从GTA3开始，Rockstar的策略就从来都是： 需求曲线永远卡在"略高于主流、远低于顶级"的甜点区； 主机先行 7—19 个月、PC 版做"第二波"硬件消费潮； 媒体装机文、厂商捆绑促销、网吧换代连续勾引； 每代 GTA 都是此后 3—5 年的跑分参照器。
GTA5可以横跨PS3到PS5的世代，不是没道理的。今年2月的报导：Take-Two Interactive 在最新一季的财报中披露，《三男一狗》的累计销量已达到2.25亿份，相比上一份财报中公布的2.2 亿份再次增长，又卖了500万份。考虑到地球上的80 亿人里有手机的大约 56 亿，没有手机（尤其是没有智能手机）的还有 20 多亿人。
每当硬件代际切换需要一个"让亿万人心甘情愿掏钱的理由"，GTA 就是那个理由。因此Rockstar宣布要让新作卖出50亿美元应该不是问题。
但是还有另外一个因素：过去一年是人类半导体科技发展彻底抛弃游戏的一年。AI 数据中心需求把 DRAM/NAND 产能瞬间掏干，民用内存一年涨 3–5 倍、固态一年涨 2–3 倍，直接后果是游戏 PC 装机成本近乎翻倍、玩家推迟升级甚至放弃 DIY。这可能是家用游戏 PC 市场二十年来第一次集体"用不起内存和硬盘"。
祝福Rockstar，请大家多多使用G-Buddy。
引擎：18 点 55 分的机核网
引擎瘫在白色塑料椅子上，腰部空着，脸冲着窗户，撇了眼手机，现在是18点55分。
18点55分，从20层高楼往下看，立交桥上的路灯会同时点亮。一整排的编辑工位空无一人。
https://image.gcores.com/278ac921c5c86ee207f3b5335c05a313-3024-4032.jpeg
Jerry挂着证件，在场馆里四处奔走，身边有人在说德语，他可能不知道，科隆在下雨。
四十二在家，双手飞快地敲击着键盘，顾不上因病而麻木的右手，因为互联网捎来了甲方的需求。
豆哥在讲日语，不禁思考地按下了电梯上的按钮，他比门口那个背着黑色双肩包，焦急等电梯的小哥还要熟悉大楼的布局。因为这里是史克威尔在东京新宿的办公大楼。
白老师在远处，被两台屏幕包围，一台竖着。光头在反射屏幕的光。
萝卜的工位上传来劣质键盘噼啪作响的敲击，一把三十五包邮的键盘一字一字敲出的是最新一期的故事节目。
“走，录。”萝卜冲我招呼。
空调会在18点59分准时关闭。我的静息心率是99。
男厕所左数第三个池子，会在冲水时爆发出如丰水期的壶口瀑布一般的声响。
而现在是22点36分，我要在十分钟内，上交一篇记事本！！！

news.title: 《神鬼寓言》导演表示，他们“并不害怕其他大型游戏”，除了《GTA 6》，以防你生活在岩石下
news.summary: "There's just one that I'm happy to avoid entirely."

content.v: Watching videogame studios try and bob and weave around Grand Theft Auto 6 's launch—especially when it was up in the air when exactly it'd come out—is a little like watching a flock of Marios (is that the correct plural noun? A mama mia of Marios?) all trying to dodge the same whomp.

As was the case with the new Fable game, which got punted over into 2027 to avoid debuting among an absolutely rammed lineup . And while Xbox was playing coy about which game it was trying to avoid back then, we've now got some soft, tongue-in-cheek confirmation that it probably was Grand Theft Auto 6, yeah.

Speaking to IGN at Gamescom 2026 , Fable's director Ralph Fulton says: "I think the rationale behind moving us out of October, the date that we were in previously, is pretty apparent to everybody. I feel great about that. I mean, I was really looking forward to shipping this game this year. I didn't want to have to do another January 1 speech to the team about ‘this is the year we ship Fable,’ which I'm now going to have to do.

"But the rationale for it is absolutely sound. I'm glad that we're avoiding that chaotic window.” For what it's worth, the window itself includes a ton of non-GTA stuff. This summer's been a touch dry on big new releases, but in the wider videogame industry you've got Onimusha: Way of the Sword , Blood of Dawnwalker , two Star Wars games, Marvel's Wolverine , Control Resonant , Gears of War: E-Day , and Phantom Blade Zero all before the year's even out.

But even Fulton cops that, yeah, the big one's the main reason: "We don't run scared of other big games. We're a big game ourselves. We hold ourselves to high standards. I'm happy to go toe-to-toe with a bunch of other games. There's just one that I'm happy to avoid entirely." Fair enough.

others.title: 《湮灭之潮》斩获科隆游戏展「最具史诗感」大奖：国产单机游戏惊艳世界舞台

content.v: 《湮灭之潮》斩获科隆游戏展「最具史诗感」大奖：国产单机游戏惊艳世界舞台

8月28日，由日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）研发并发行的国产单机动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，在 2026 科隆游戏展大奖（gamescom award 2026）颁奖典礼上正式摘得「最具史诗感」（The Most Epic Game）大奖。这款出自成都团队的处女作，力压《红色沙漠》（Crimson Desert）、《战锤40K》（Warhammer 40K）等国际 IP 胜出。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787927932_444471_jpg_r.jpg
力压国际大作，成都团队首作扬威科隆
gamescom award 由德国数字游戏文化基金会主办，是全球最大游戏盛会科隆游戏展的官方奖项。值得关注的是，「最具史诗感」大奖的往届得主中不乏全球顶级 IP：《塞尔达传说》《怪物猎人：荒野》《生化危机：安魂曲》均曾摘得此桂冠，《湮灭之潮》此番能从中突围，含金量不言而喻。
继全新宣传片「旧日之纱」于开幕夜直播（Opening Night Live）首映、并于科隆展览中心 6 号馆 B-050 展位迎来公开试玩之后，本作凭借酣畅淋漓的战斗体验、电影级的演出品质、独特的幻影骑士系统与史诗级 Boss 战，征服了到场媒体与玩家。将亚瑟王传奇融入「异世界入侵下的破碎伦敦」的独特设定，正是这一殊荣的最佳注脚。
从格雯德琳的情感旅程，到召唤圆桌骑士对抗半神
“科隆游戏展是行业内最具影响力的展会之一。我们能在这里获得『最具史诗感』大奖，感到非常荣幸。”《湮灭之潮》游戏监制陈琦表示，“从开发之初，我们的目标就是以中国团队的视角，改编亚瑟王经典。这座奖杯，是对我们开发团队辛勤付出、创造力与热情的极大肯定。在众多优秀的提名作品能最终胜出，我们倍感鼓舞，不胜感激。”
自《黑神话：悟空》之后，《湮灭之潮》成为又一款在科隆游戏展斩获大奖的国产单机游戏。从成都东郊记忆的千人试玩会，到德国科隆 gamescom 的领奖台，《湮灭之潮》正将它的瑰奇幻想带向更广阔的世界。
关于《湮灭之潮》
《湮灭之潮》是一款日蚀边缘工作室研发并发行的国产单机买断制骑士幻想动作冒险游戏。游戏基于虚幻 5 引擎打造，仅登录 PC 及主机平台，游戏以「异世界入侵下的破碎伦敦」为核心设定，玩家将扮演灾难中的幸存者格雯德琳（Gwendolyn），在现实与幻境交织的伦敦废墟中展开冒险，对抗由异世界而来的威胁，并逐步揭开世界倾覆背后的秘密。
《湮灭之潮》现正面向 PC（Steam 与 Epic Games Store）、PlayStation 及 XBOX 平台开发中。
-官方网站： https://playtoa.com
-Steam 页面： https://store.steampowered.com/app/3292470/
关于日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）

日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）是一家面向全球玩家开发及发行 PC 和主机游戏的工作室，总部位于四川成都。工作室当前正在开发基于亚瑟王神话的动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，团队由 150 余名开发者组成，成员曾参与《如龙》（Yakuza）《荣耀战魂》（For Honor）《刺客信条》（Assassin's Creed）《女神异闻录》（Persona）与《波斯王子》（Prince of Persia）等知名游戏的研发。

news.title: Sabre Boss 对实体游戏的消亡和游戏机价格上涨的反应
news.summary: 2026 has been full of big storylines in gaming, including Sony's announcement that it will end support for phy

content.v: 2026 has been full of big storylines in gaming, including Sony's announcement that it will end support for physical PlayStation game discs in 2028 and the trend of consoles getting increasingly expensive. Tim Willits, the chief creative officer at Saber Interactive, caught up with GameSpot at Gamescom this week to discuss these topics and offer up a bizarre-sounding possibility for an "AI box" for games.

He said he was "surprised how upset people were" about Sony ending support for physical game discs. Willits said he hasn't bought a physical game "in a long time" because he enjoys the convenience of digital games. Willits is not alone, as the share of digital game sales is growing at numerous companies.

At the same time, Sony continues to sell millions of physical game discs annually . Willits said Saber still makes "a lot of money" from physical games, especially in Europe, but the trends are different in North America, he observed.

Willits went on to say he had an interaction with someone recently who asked him to sign a copy of Doom 3, a game he worked on when he was with id Software. "So for me personally, I'll miss that in the future," he said.
An AI game box?
Part of what many people enjoy about physical games is collecting the boxes they come in and presenting them on their shelves.
Willits said he thinks someone in the future might create some kind of "AI box" into which players can "upload all your games."
"So maybe someone will do that," he said.
Rising console prices

Another major storyline in gaming in 2026 has been how video game consoles today are more expensive than ever . There are numerous reasons for this, including US President Donald Trump's tariffs, the AI-fueled impact on component and memory prices, and more.

Sony and Microsoft raised prices on PlayStation and Xbox consoles so much that the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles are now $150+ more expensive than they were when they launched in 2020. Nintendo, meanwhile, is hiking the price of the Switch 2 in September.

For his part, Willits said it's "shocking how expensive" it has become to buy a new console today, adding that it will "be interesting to see" how Sony and Microsoft manage this as they look to release new consoles.

A new report from Ampere Analysis said that if next-gen consoles do, in fact, come in at $1,000 or more, that could have a dramatic, negative effect on the market. To be sure, Sony and Microsoft have yet to detail their plans for new consoles, so there is no word yet on how much they might cost or when they could be release.
In other news, Willits told GameSpot more about the company’s plans to use AI in game development and how the company claims it will never fire anyone and replace them with AI .

content.v: 在ChinaJoy期间，我有幸参加了一场《异克斯小队》的线下试玩，也就是最近在科隆游戏展上放出新片的三人联机PVE动作射击游戏。
哪怕把游戏本身放在一边，作为一次线下闭门试玩来说，也是体验不错的。出于其三人联机PVE的本质，我与另外两位来自其他媒体的老师组成了一队，由我担任队长，一起简单体验了这款游戏，结下了战友情。是的，我们这个行业偶尔也是能出现一些同行情谊的。
《异克斯小队》由加拿大知名团队 Behaviour Interactive研发，国内由腾讯游戏发行，STC游戏产品部合作出品。海外由 Level Infinite 发行，TEAM SHOOTER & CREATIVE合作出品。游戏将于2027 年登陆 PC / PS5 / Xbox Series X|S，并在即日起开放愿望单。
该作的制作人以及核心团队有着丰富的3A游戏制作经验，参加过《孤岛惊魂2》，《彩虹六号：异种》《全境封锁》《刺客信条》等作品的开发。
悲催的打工人，在异形遍布的行星表面上作战
媒体老师们被分为三人一组，组队开始游戏。我与一名有一定游戏经验的同行老师，以及一名几乎没有动作射击游戏经验的媒体老师组成了小队，先从低难度开始体验。
https://image.gcores.com/28858b78bcc5e1fae2dbccde33d494bd-828-466.png
在这个三人成行的游戏模式里，玩家在出发之前要先由队长选择任务目标，这将决定前往的星球，难度，以及任务目标和敌人种类。然后大家再选择这次出击要配备的装备，包括主武器，特殊武器，道具，以及最重要的：武器上的模组。
我们一开始被禁止使用任何模组，因为模组十分强力，大家先从未装模组的朴素武器开始体验，这时我很轻易联想到了《星际战甲》的模组系统。但是后来体验到本作的模组系统后，意识到也不尽一样。
三人出发进入地图后，随时与“公司总部”保持通讯，队长打开地图之后标记位置，全队一起向目标进发。沿途有充满敌意的野生生物前来阻挠，也被我们的步枪轻松解决。至于敌人本身，很难用某种地球生物来把他们简单类比，只能形容为各种奇怪的外星动物，攻击方式也多种多样。有的喜欢突脸，有的喜欢在远处默默对玩家蓄个大的。
玩家之间也存在足额的友军伤害，一不注意就会打死自己人。打死自己人之后，可以使用一个复活枪把一个新的队友“射到”目标位置，同时在目标位置还会形成爆炸，杀伤范围内的其他队友或敌人，并把刚复活的队友投入险境。
玩家扮演的角色名为“Exterminauts”，这个词是由“灭害”和“宇航员”融合而成，基本也代表了玩家的核心任务：消灭生物，完成公司指定的工作。
来到任务地点后，通常就是一些非常简单的疏通，激活，防守类的工作，完成一项工作就可以前往下一个地点，也有许多支线任务供玩家选择。时不时地图上会突然弹出一个存在时间任务的临时任务，想要拿到奖励的话就要立刻前往。这种任务的本质是你的老板突然决定让你“加个班”。
https://image.gcores.com/814aee487caa40739f39abd8a1c3d65f-828-466.png
https://image.gcores.com/39463b0fc6d1d36601ffe6a94f0132cf-828-466.png
在这个简单难度里，我们体验到了与《绝地潜兵2》类似的玩法流程，而更多的差异性体验随着难度的提高逐渐浮出水面。
在中等难度下，大家开始研究给武器装什么模组。游戏提供了丰富的构筑方案，在稍微研究之后我给自己构筑了一套以暴击触发特效为核心思路的模组，而我的队友则构筑了一套以治疗和生存为主的玩法。再次进入游戏后，随着我一梭子子弹打到大型怪物身上，许多酸液，闪电，火焰开始迸发，特效满天飞，原本很肉的敌人在我的build面前被瞬间融化，感受到了一种数值上的爽快。
https://image.gcores.com/334748502db813b9f3bcc1b9f7b2aecd-828-466.png
而我那个生存治疗构筑的队友基本失去了杀伤能力，但是凭借极强的治疗效率跟在我身边给我补血，我们基本上组成了一种输出与治疗的强强配合。这种相对“极化”的构筑体验让我意识到这也许是这个游戏的核心乐趣，这个乐趣主要来自于武器模组的选择和配合，而制作团队也说，这些模组不会难以获得，或者让大家肝很久才能得到。
在撤离阶段，地图上的敌人会来围攻撤离点，这个时候三位队员可以比赛谁杀的更多，屏幕上会出现一个计分板。我自己杀够了全队总分数的95%，可见正确的模组构筑的重要性。
除此之外，玩家在游戏内可以获得弹药和物资的补给，但这些补给也是要花公司预算的，而这个预算会从玩家这次任务的工资里扣除，那么如何用最少的资源完成任务来赚取更多的利润也成了玩家要考虑的问题。
https://image.gcores.com/a3917273287ac54805e7a4fad047ba97-828-466.png
勇敢的打工人，在大企业的压迫下维持生活
在《异克斯小队》里，玩家也服从一家超大法西斯组织（为啥要说“也”）。
《异克斯小队》的故事发生在遥远的天穹星（Tian）。这颗星球上发现了一种全新的奇迹能源“多态等离子体”，引爆了一场席卷星际巨头的“淘金热”，也带动了开采、精炼与运输技术的飞速发展。然而这种物质对于许多异形生物来说如同蜜糖一般诱人，于是企业与生物之间的战争愈演愈烈，玩家们置身其中，又要完成开采任务，又要消灭异形生物。
https://image.gcores.com/31213df77528965e75261e3bd66be692-828-466.png
https://image.gcores.com/121a500e1b979df5429176dbf62dc7f7-828-466.png

在美术方面，玩家拥有自定义宇航服的丰富选项，但大部分设计思路都围绕着“蓝领”这个主题展开，荧光黄色的醒目配色在欧美人看来就是工人制服特有的颜色，所以许多宇航服也都是这种包含工地元素的服装。从硬质安全帽、护目面罩、隔音耳罩、呼吸防护面具，到绑带、护垫、反光条、耐磨工作手套、随手可取的工具袋、连体工装和安全靴，装备清一色是一线劳保防护用品，细节拉满。原因也很实在：在遍地异种、险象环生的异星上，把自己保护好，永远是第一要务。
https://image.gcores.com/8c9f4e7a30769bd70e1cab621b4adfee-828-466.png
而武器方面，除了工人们防身使用的步枪，冲锋枪，霰弹枪等，真正的大杀器反而是一个个“工具”。比如原本用来冷冻和稳定环境的冷冻器，在玩家的小小“超载”之后，可以发射出相当惊人的巨型冷冻气体，一瞬间把目光所及范围内的一切变成冰雪世界，包括喜欢乱动的可怕敌人，以及你无辜的队友。相信我，发射超载冰冻炮的那一刹那，视觉效果真的很炸裂。
https://image.gcores.com/8ae76b740314bfeba1d12acfd83f25e5-828-466.png
要想超载这些工具让他们的发射变得无比强大，需要从玩家的电池里汲取一些电力。这些电力除了可以超载武器，也可以用来超载一些“谜题”，直接跳过谜题交互完成任务，大幅加速任务进程。是把电力用在消灭敌人上，还是用在消灭解谜流程上，就看三人的配合了。
也正是这些风味化的设计，一定程度上拉开了与《绝地潜兵》等竞品的体验，找到了属于自己的风格。
强大的打工人，最终会赚个盆满钵满……吗
https://image.gcores.com/97399c4dbf1d47b383692268e8fafb95-828-466.png
最后，是与发行团队的一些简单沟通，以及我的一些思考。

在他们看来，这是一款想要塑造“蓝领英雄”的游戏，开发灵感来自许多作品，比如《捉鬼敢死队》《黑衣人》《异形》《绝世天劫》等。这些作品中的主角都不是超人，没有超能力——他们像《绝世天劫》里的蓝领工人一样，粗犷、务实，拥有厉害的技术和武器，对资本主义、权力和高层管理抱有不信任感。他们直率、甚至有些粗犷和暴力，但也非常可爱和直接。他们的生存环境是高压的打工环境——长时间工作、需要薪酬回报、不断加班、被资本主义压榨。这些乍一听似乎都能切中当下的时代性。
但是在两个小时不到的游玩里，由于游玩时间有限以及没能从头开始游戏，并没有太能感受到那种非常代入的，为黑心大企业卖命的氛围，主角三人所做的工作也没让我觉得充斥着所谓的“蓝领”气质。要想充分感受到这部分是否做的优秀，还得花更多时间游玩正式版本。
我对发行团队负责人说：《绝地潜兵2》以及其他同类游戏的成功并不在于他真的把战斗玩法做的多有趣，而是只要我打开游戏就能身临其境，为了“超级地球”或者“帝皇”，我就可以无数次再开一把这些游戏。如果《异克斯小队》在这方面下足功夫，那就能真正戳中我的好球区。
但话又说回来，我所举的这些例子的确也都是已经有许多年的社区耕耘之后的结果了。要想在这个赛道上用一个全新IP抢一杯羹，难度自然是相当大。
要想让玩家切实感受到与自己控制的打工人的共情和相互鼓励，一定要去找真正的打工人，去找各行各业一线奋战的真正打工人来取取经，了解他们的思考方式和工作上的困境，只有这样才能在氛围和叙事上闯出自己的一片天。
另外，这款游戏也有他自己的“绝活”，那就是在长线运营方面非常清晰的自我认知，他们决定狠狠的“卷”（误用）一把同行竞品们。
以目前发行方规划的想法是，这款游戏将会以每三个月为一个赛季，不同主题、不同运营活动；每六周一个Battle Pass，包含新皮肤、新武器、职业模块，以及多样化的活动等。
我认为，只要更新频率够快够勤，内容够多，玩家自然会愿意经常回来玩一玩。
最后，在售价方面，这款游戏的售价不会高于同类产品。
完整版暂时计划于明年发布，但综上所述，如果你是一个喜欢三人合作PVE动作射击游戏的玩家，这是一款值得保持关注和期待的作品，等到正式发售后可以再看一看。
https://image.gcores.com/61bea3ea4c1c1756197bc2011982efdd-828-466.png

news.title: 有关“动漫 GTA”游戏 Ananta 的所有关键细节
news.summary: Does whatever a (legally distinct) Spider(-Man) can.

content.v: Ananta remained a mystery for many years, but it's finally got a solid 2027 release date. Plus, there's now plenty of proper gameplay footage and hands-on impressions to peruse in the meantime, letting us all in on the secret of what else "anime GTA" is actually offering.

From its release date, to characters, to gacha and gameplay, I'll explain everything you need to know about Ananta (previously Project Mugen), so you can decide if any of its approximately one million features are for you or not.
Ananta release date and (lack of) betas
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dHcEhD48H5ksno95smXfX9.jpg
Ananta release date

After years of no-showing at big events, it finally turned up to Gamescom's 2026 Opening Night Live to announce that Ananta is releasing on January 15, 2027 for PC, PS5, and mobile. You can play it via Steam, or its own separate launcher.
Is there an Ananta beta?

There has never been an open beta for Ananta , and it's not looking like there will be one before the game's January launch either. That's uncommon for gacha games, but Ananta is developed by a NetEase studio, and NetEase's live service games don't tend to get open betas—just closed private testing. So all is (disappointingly) normal here.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/STDovjEUUMtKQMdrHzk3o9.jpg
Is pre-registration for Ananta open?

Yep! You can head on over to Ananta's official site and sign-up for pre-registration goodies right now. The rewards are the usual handful of weirdly-named currencies with unspecified purposes (y'all know what a Golvent is?), but there's also a regular ol' outfit up for grabs as the top milestone.

It's worth keeping in mind that Ananta will likely dish out these rewards to every player at launch, not just those who pre-register. This is the norm for live service anime games, but there is a chance Ananta bucks this trend, as nothing's been confirmed yet.
Ananta Trailers
Latest trailer

As well as highlighting your main character, the Captain, and their crew's bizarre shenanigans about Nova City, Ananta's newest trailer revealed its second city: Chongxiao. Its other location, Nova City, seems more urban and Tokyo-inspired, while Chongxiao seems to be using China's Hangzhou as a reference. It's a little more tranquil, with scenic lakes, greenery, and historic architecture.
First trailer

If you want to know how it was revealed three years ago, you can check out Ananta's very first trailer above. Anana changed more than its name since then—its city and protagonist looked a lot different, and it had a more serious tone.
Ananta gameplay details
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Mp8syBd9Xq8BbaYD35pYX9.jpg
Our Ananta preview

PC Gamer's Wes Fenlon went hands on with Ananta at Tokyo Game Show last year, and he thought that although Ananta is borrowing—or brazenly copying—a lot, that it "might have some wild-ass ideas of its own, too."

He found the influences of the Batman Arkham games, Sleeping Dogs, Uncharted, and Spider-Man pretty clear, but they all worked well enough. "This may be a game that does dozens of things acceptably well. And it made me laugh," he said. You can read Wes's full Ananta preview for more details.
Ananta gameplay

Ananta is a free-to-play urban open-world RPG that may look like the next Genshin Impact or Neverness to Everness, but actually has more in common with GTA, the Arkham series, and Insomniac's Spider-Man. Just, you know, with 500% more anime-ified silliness.

While there seems to be some underlying sinister plot involving supernatural occurrences unleashed upon the dual cities of Tokyo-like Nova City and Hangzhou-like Chongxiao, Ananta is leaning harder into its goofy side. With a social media and follower system linked to your "Yeet Squad" saving the world.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sbYNdiM86rUDYx2spqaKW9.jpg

At any moment you might be swinging through the city skylines (à la Peter Parker) on your way to start a mission. Or you could be swimming, driving, boating, or gliding your way to the start point instead. While on a mission, it might be a Batman-like infiltration of slowly picking off enemies, or scoping out the place with gadgets that wouldn't be out of place in a Watch Dogs game. Or you could just wind up on a classic "murder the baddies" mission.

While killing said baddies, you can whip out guns like an assault rifle and rocket launcher, or you could put your fists to the test and time hits and combos as enemies surround you—maybe use the environment to bash a head or two while you're at. If melee weapons are more your thing, bats, swords, tennis rackets, mallets, and golf clubs are also at your disposal. Add on each character's unique attacks (like Alan's ice yo-yos, Bansy's paintguns, and Taffy's motorbike-chucking), and you've got one very versatile combat system at play.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZY3WgkNBGq8Rauijmbmya9.jpg

Confirmed open-world activities include racing, dating, arcade mini-games, going to the gym, watching TV, shopping for new fits, customising houses, and picking up and carrying around chunky cats. For reasons. There's also a chance you might swap characters and catch one of your buds doing any of these things, as a GTA 6-style character switching system has been seen in trailers and demo gameplay.
So yeah, there's a lot. Honestly I can't tell if all that variety will be any good or just feel like Ananta is throwing everything at the wall, but I'm open to being persuaded.
Does Ananta have multiplayer?
Not at launch , but the developers have stated that the team is looking into a four-player co-op mode where you'd be able to complete missions or "dungeons" together.
Is Ananta gacha?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hPkg2saQosm5gWbYxYHJa9.jpg

Despite all appearances, no, Ananta is not a gacha game . Well, at the very least, its characters aren't obtained from gacha pulls . Instead, they're all available completely for free by just playing through the game.

It is a free-to-play, live-service game, though, so Ananta will be looking to part you with your money somehow. Clothes, vehicles, and homes are the only confirmed cosmetics you'll buy with real-world money right now. But nobody knows 100% for sure if these cosmetics are available for outright purchase, or pulled through their own gacha systems. The only thing the developers have confirmed is that characters are not linked to gacha.
Wait, what's Project Mugen?

The title "Ananta" was only revealed in December 2024, before that, the game was solely referred to as Project Mugen (well, Project Mugen and "anime GTA" in some circles). So if you ever see a trailer or some gameplay for a game that looks mighty like Ananta, it's probably some pre- title reveal footage.
Ananta characters
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ncU8sn3FQHv2Qk242ozXn9.jpg
A mix of trailers, social media posts, and the official website has revealed 16 Ananta characters so far:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/EvxQDRqJuz2KVqWxSQUJY9.jpg
There are also two characters with unknown names:

If you're looking at this list trying to suss out who might work well in a team, it's most likely a waste of time. From what's been revealed so far, Ananta is not a game about fast-action character-swapping. Instead, you're either on a mission as one character for an extended period of time, or you can switch to a specific character when you need them for exploration and puzzle-solving purposes.

Interestingly, it has been confirmed that each character has their own story, and we'll get to experience different lives depending on the character we're currently playing. That's 16 storylines already, if all of these characters are available at launch.

news.title: Gears Of War: E-Day 有一个受大逃杀启发的 PvP 模式，你可以在其中剥掉敌人的肉
news.summary: Gears of War games have had some of the best multiplayer action around ever since the days of the first game,

content.v: Gears of War games have had some of the best multiplayer action around ever since the days of the first game, and for Gears of War: E-Day , developers at The Coalition are looking to give fans plenty of options for online fun. While the game's new take on Horde mode is shaping up to be the ultimate battlefield for players to enter, fans of traditional deathmatches aren't being left out in the cold either. At Gamescom, The Coalition spoke to GameSpot about E-Day's new Crucible mode and how it uses some battle royale inspiration to create a fast-paced round of 4v4 action.

The PvP mode blends your typical Gears of War spatial control with battle royale mechanics, as teams must grab the Power Core, bring it to a designated active zone, and hold their position while the opposition closes in on them. The catch is that the Power Core restricts your mobility and limits which weapons you can use, meaning that your team will need to watch your back. The core stores a close-range electrical charge attack, and the carrier can unleash a charged blast at point-blank range to fry an enemy player, but this attack does have a long recharge time. Once the Power Core enters the scoring zone, it will begin to shrink. This, in turn, creates high-stakes zone pressure, forcing players into brutal standoffs as the space around them tightens.

"It's very obviously inspired by battle royale games, but it's on a Gear-sized PVP map," creative director Matt Searcy said to GameSpot. "At the beginning of the map, there's lots of mobility, teams are moving around, you're trading the Power Core back and forth. But as the map goes on, you see defensive teams start to build up a front around the player they're protecting. And then, in awesome Gears fashion, the thing you're going to hold puts you at a slight disadvantage. So we gave you a heavy weapon that's basically a giant battery pack, and if somebody gets close to you within a really tight range, you can strip all the flesh off their body with a charge attack."

Crucible is one of four PvP modes that will be available on launch day. The multiplayer options include traditional Team Deathmatch, Conquest, and Demolition, each of which has been reworked for E-Day. Team Deathmatch has a dynamic respawn system to move spawn locations closer to where fights are breaking out, Conquest puts its own spin on the classic King of the Hill experience, and Demolition revolves around teams planting bombs on enemy territory.

Gears of War: E-Day launches on October 6 for Xbox Series X|S and PC, and it'll also be a day-one release through Xbox Game Pass. For more on the game, you can read up on how The Coalition solved its biggest lore problem.

news.title: 《NBA 2K27》对球场两端进行重大升级
news.titleEn: NBA 2K27 Is Making Major Upgrades to Both Ends of the Court

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/18/nbathumbmycareer-1787076223072.png
说实话，NBA 休赛期已经出现了足够多的情节曲折，足以填满 MyCAREER 过场动画。勒布朗·詹姆斯 (LeBron James) 奔赴费城，湖人队 (Lakers) 卷入了一场所有权闹剧，据称估值高达 125 亿美元，而维克多·文班亚马 (Victor Wembanyama) 从篮球界才华横溢的外星人变成了《NBA 2K27》的代言人。 2026-27赛季还没开始，我就已经叫暂停了。
幸运的是，新的《NBA 2K》即将推出，让我有事可做。在该系列的大型季前赛揭晓了几乎所有模式的细节之后，以下是我对我的篮球同胞们最应该兴奋的内容的氛围检查。
游戏玩法想要在攻防两端发挥作用
《NBA 2K27》提供了一个非常令人信服的案例，证明今年最大的变化并不是找到一个强大的招式并不断地使用它，直到我的对手愤怒退出。进攻端获得了新的玩具，包括上跨、下跨、动态上篮引擎和扩展的运球定制，让我能够更好地控制如何创造空间和攻击篮筐。
防守也没有把屁股放在板凳上。重新设计了举手防守，彻底修改了投篮比赛系统，扩大了防守界限，并且新的碰撞系统应该赋予身体对抗更多的分量。换句话说，《NBA 2K27》正试图让球场两端发挥作用，这对于那些曾经看过队友冲向三分线并认为防守是别人的问题的人来说听起来是个好消息。
MyCAREER 上了一堂历史课

MyCAREER is getting a particularly juicy addition this year, with five playable eras allowing me to build a basketball career across different points in NBA history. Quick e.g.: I can start in the Magic vs. Bird Era of 1984 and work through the decades, all the way to the Steph Era of 2016. Nice.

Then there's Fire & Concrete, an 11-chapter cinematic story featuring rapper and actor Vince Staples. That's more than twice the length of last year's story, so there should be considerably more time for my MyPLAYER to make questionable life choices while looking suspiciously good in expensive digital clothing.

Even better, NBA 2K27 introduces co-op MyCAREER for the first time. A friend can join my career through Running Mate Trace Miller, meaning I can finally share the grind instead of merely arguing about whose build is broken in the group chat.
MyPLAYERs to compete together across the City's activities.

Crew players also get a new home with Crew HQ, which provides dedicated space for practice, ranked competition, private games, Crew progression and seasonal tournaments. Meanwhile, the City itself has been refreshed with new environments and activities including Rucker Park in Street Kings, Casual Corner and Daily Rivals.

With 40 REP tiers available at launch, there should be plenty of incentive to keep grinding. I'll just have to remember that the sun does eventually come up, no matter how convincing the "one more game" argument sounds at 2:47am.
MyNBA puts me in the front office
如果我对乐趣的看法是减少脚踝骨折和更多的电子表格，那么 MyNBA 将以回归基本的改革重返球场。该模式越来越关注其基本的特许经营系统，包括现实的 CBA 合同谈判和新的 GM 信托系统，这应该会让我的决定更有分量。
然后，MyNBA Legacy 的目标就变得非常雄心勃勃。这种新的单人 RPG 风格的体验让我可以在前台管理球队，同时也可以像同一个锁定的球员一样在球场上占据主导地位，而球队的窗口期长达 100 年。这足够的时间来建立一个王朝，摧毁它，重建它，然后想知道为什么我给了那个中锋一份七年的合同。
MyTEAM 希望每张牌都发挥作用
MyTEAM 也发生了一些重大的进展变化。交易所现在将接受我收藏中的任何玩家卡，让那些在我的阵容后面积攒虚拟灰尘的卡再次有机会为这一事业做出贡献。
全新的球员 XP 系统将让每张球员卡升级并解锁奖励，同时旋转多人游戏模式、统一的拍卖行、新的球员卡平行和扩展的突破进程增加了更多方式来构建、升级和玩我梦想的 NBA 和 WNBA 阵容。
本质上，我的板凳变得更深了。
W 和 MyWNBA 做主
《NBA 2K27》也为其 WNBA 模式提供了更多的发挥空间。 W 和 MyWNBA 都提供专门的单人游戏体验，以及随用随建的进度系统、更新的游戏属性系统以及新的团队徽章和队友徽章。

Those badges are designed to build chemistry and give me two distinct upgrade paths, while MyWNBA adds more tools for running a WNBA franchise from the front office. It's another sign that NBA 2K27 is treating its various forms of basketball as more than just different courts sharing the same ball.
MyPLAYER can travel with me

Perhaps the slickest quality-of-life addition is the new NBA 2K HQ companion app, which went live August 21. It lets you build and edit MyPLAYERs on the go before uploading those builds directly to my console, while QR-code sharing makes it easier to send builds to friends. The app also handles real-time messaging, Crew management, leaderboards and mobile-exclusive daily rewards. So even when I'm away from the console, the grind doesn't have to ride the pine.

Taken together, NBA 2K27 looks like a game that's trying to give every kind of hooper a reason to check back in. Whether I want to recreate basketball history, build a MyPLAYER, run a century-long franchise, collect cards, dominate The City or simply jump online with friends, there's a sizable menu of new plays to run.

And with the real NBA coming off an offseason featuring LeBron's move to Philly, the Lakers' ownership saga and a schedule that already has a Finals rematch lined up for Christmas Day, there's no shortage of inspiration.
NBA 2K27 tips off September 4, with Deluxe and Ultra Edition players getting an early start from August 27.

news.title: Grand Theft Auto III – The Legacy Review
news.summary: Replaying the pioneering 2001 classic 25 years later and paying tribute to the game that didn’t just change th

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-3-legacy-review-thumb-1787907520325.png

Over the next few months, I’m going to be taking a look back at each of the core Grand Theft Auto games and replaying them in the lead-up to the arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6. What we’ll be putting together won’t be traditional re-reviews, and they won’t come with any new IGN score, but they will re-examine what made each GTA remarkable upon the time of its release. By the end of the project, using GTA’s previously six-star wanted level, you should be able to get an idea of where each of these games roughly rank in my long-term love for this series.
Today, we go back to the game that changed this series forever: Grand Theft Auto III.

Playing Grand Theft Auto III in 2026 is a little like watching a home movie of Usain Bolt learning to walk. It’s a little wobbly, and it hasn’t quite got the whole process worked out yet, but through a modern lens it comes with a fascinating awareness you’re seeing the first steps of a field-defining juggernaut. In the late ’90s, GTA games had found success showing us the unique brand of freedom they offered within their sandbox-style cities – but the old school, top-down approach was a dated aesthetic in contrast to the fully 3D worlds that were first beginning to emerge during this era. In 2001, GTA III arrived as a completely different proposition, instantly reinventing the series as the new cutting edge of open-world action games.

It’s true that its already annoying targeting system is doubly frustrating by modern standards, and its time-consuming mission restarts do feel particularly punitive 25 years on. However, I’ve found it impossible not to admire how well it otherwise weaves together its driving, action, story, and exploration within a dynamic 3D world, considering it accomplished this before there was any sort of proper blueprint for doing so. Sure, GTA III didn’t get everything right immediately – but you’ve got to walk before you can run.

Playing GTA III in such close proximity to GTA 2, I’m actually quickly reminded of how immediately the former feels like the game that was actually teased by the latter’s eye-catching, live-action intro. The gritty, New York-based short promotional film Rockstar produced for GTA 2 (and subsequently trimmed down to serve as its intro) never felt remotely connected to the quasi-cyberpunk setting of that game – but it feels perfectly aligned to GTA III. The fact that GTA III made good on a cheque that GTA 2 bounced made it all the more special upon its arrival. GTA 2 only left me desperately wanting a game in the spirit of what I saw in that promo film. Two years later, GTA III delivered it.

GTA III kept a couple of noticeable elements established by its predecessor – like its hilarious array of custom radio commercials, its random fascination with Elvis Presley, and even an optional top-down camera – but it completely discarded its divisive time period, indeterminable location, and retro-futuristic fleet of vehicles. Instead, it opted for something credible, contemporary, and recognisable, and returned to the original GTA’s New York homage: Liberty City.
It’s a Bent World

While GTA III’s voice cast is a murderers’ row of iconic Hollywood crime fiction actors – including Frank Vincent, Michael Madsen, Joe Pantoliano, Robert Loggia, Michael Rapaport, Kyle MacLachlan, and Debi Mazar – none gallops away as the star of the game. In fact, with a silent protagonist and an otherwise very simple story propped up by a supporting crew of broad and largely one-dimensional criminal stereotypes, it’s Liberty City itself that perhaps emerges as GTA III’s greatest character.

Liberty City is split into three distinct boroughs that are rationed out as the story unfolds. We begin in Portland, an area defined by its grimy industrial sector and seedy red light district, before scampering to the Manhattan-inspired Staunton Island when the situation turns sour. Staunton Island is a wholly different backdrop; it’s highly commercial and features towering skyscrapers and a lush and centrally located park. The third area is Shoreside Vale, which is a leafy, suburban zone that’s otherwise dominated by a large airport and dam. Unfortunately, Shoreside Vale is actually the least interesting of the three boroughs, lacking both the personality of Portland and the density of Staunton Island. I’ll give it a nod for being the home of the infamously tricky to fly Dodo, but it’s otherwise a bit of a disappointing shift.

The dimensions of Liberty City are extremely modest compared to its later reinvention in GTA IV – and it’s absolutely dwarfed by modern open-world standards – but that was of no consequence back in 2001. At that time, it was unlike any game world we’d ever visited – and its nature as a place where day became night and clear weather turned to rain made it somewhere that felt alive in a fundamentally new way. Stand still in GTA III’s Liberty City and life will simply go on around you. Traffic flows, pedestrians pass, and the Earth spins. None of this would be particularly impressive today, but it was back then. The feeling I got re-immersing myself in GTA III and being transported back to that moment in my life has been a potent one.
You Better Drive, Brother

The template DMA Design established for the top-down GTA games unsurprisingly remained in place for GTA III. That is, whether you’re behind the wheel or on foot, everything happens in the same space. There are no “driving” levels or “action” levels. There are no levels at all. There’s one map, and player agency is the number one priority. Yes, there are many instances where the missions may compel you to use a particular vehicle but, for the most part, you’re in complete control of how you move around the world. Grab whatever car you want, and head in any direction you choose.

25 years on, the novelty of this freedom has somewhat expired – but in 2001 it was really nothing short of revolutionary. The powerful might of the PlayStation 2 had given GTA III the ability to push far beyond what was possible on the original PlayStation, transforming its top-down chaos into something modern, immediate, dangerous, and cinematic. Very simply, you were now in the world – not floating above it. It no longer felt like playing cops and robbers with toy cars – it felt like holidaying in a Michael Mann action sequence.

GTA III’s driving physics are a little slippier and floatier than they are in the more modern installments of the series, but they’re still quite easy to come to terms with in 2026. They don’t quite have the weight and inertia needed to be able to consistently flick them into extravagant J-turns and the like, but they feel otherwise adequate. There are many open-world action/driving games released over the last 25 years that I’ve found twitchier, sloppier, or more superficial than GTA III, that much I can assure you. At any rate, being behind the wheel is also the only way to hear all the wacky radio commercials, which once again had me grinning – or the cavalcade of insane callers on Chatterbox FM.

news.title: 在 GTA 6: Extended Look 显示 Rockstar 的游戏以 30 FPS 运行后，技术专家表示 60 FPS 的主机版本“极不可能”，即使在 PC 上也“真正具有挑战性”
news.summary: Getting Rockstar's hugely ambitious GTA 6 running at 60fps on current consoles will be "extremely unlikely", t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/gta6-satire-news-1787848953836.jpg

Getting Rockstar's hugely ambitious GTA 6 running at 60fps on current consoles will be "extremely unlikely", the tech experts at Digital Foundry have said, after analysis of footage from the Grand Theft Auto 6: Extended Look.

Yesterday's 27-minute reveal featured 30fps footage of the game on Netflix, YouTube, and in the raw file made available by Rockstar to download — and this is seemingly how we should all expect the game to look when it arrives on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S this November.

While 30fps might seem low compared to the frame counts of other modern gaming blockbusters, Rockstar appears to be targeting this level to maximize the sheer detail on offer in every one of those frames, Digital Foundry believes.

"It's clear that the focus was absolutely maximising the level of visual detail at a fixed 30fps frame-rate on all platforms," Digital Foundry wrote in an Extended Look deep dive article. "The rendering, simulation and presentation have all been tuned around that constraint - and the result is an unprecedented level of density, material quality and world coherence, with trade-offs landing primarily in image quality and animation smoothness rather than systemic scale or fidelity."

Specifically, the report goes on to heap praise on GTA 6's character rendering, including skin shading that makes sweat and make-up look convincing, and "huge generation improvements to hair simulation" that allows Lucia's locks to behave realistically with convincing snap-back motions, delayed follow-through and impressive "base-to-tip motion."

In terms of resolution, Digital Foundry suspects the PS5's internal rendering is clocked at 1440p without DRS, without any strong evidence of FSR 2 or TAA upscaling being used. This can lead to "a degree of softness, visible geometric aliasing and shimmer on fine details," Digital Foundry wrote, but no sign of frame-rate drops that have hampered previous entries in the series at launch. While improvements for the beefier PS5 Pro are only speculative, improved image quality and ray-tracing were mooted as more likely, over any transformative boost in performance.

"The evidence suggests that the game maintains its 33.3ms cadence with care, and Rockstar has clearly spent immense effort balancing CPU and GPU workloads to fully saturate the hardware," Digital Foundry continued. "That makes a 60fps version extremely unlikely on console hardware - there's no way to regain enough GPU and particularly CPU time to make a 16.7ms update rate work without compromising the world."

The game is carefully balanced in terms of its ambition, then, with the downside that there's likely little left in the tank to enable a 60fps mode down the line — at least on the current crop of consoles. But how about PC?

"Looking ahead to other console versions and the presumably-coming-eventually PC release, some level of caution is required," Digital Foundry wrote. "The PC platform ought to allow for higher resolutions, especially with the benefit of more modern temporal upscalers like DLSS, alongside increased RT sample counts, longer draw distances and so on. However, the CPU demands of a world this complex - tuned around console Zen 2 cores at 30fps - could make hitting 60fps genuinely challenging in a way we don't often see, and will likely require a high-end CPU like a recent Ryzen X3D to avoid bottlenecks."

IGN is one of the very few outlets to have been given an exclusive preview of GTA 6 . We also have details on GTA 6's romance system , how long GTA 6 will take to beat , every GTA 6 side activity we've spotted so far , and how GTA 6's bigger map compares to past Rockstar games as part of our exhaustive and ongoing coverage. Up to speed on all that? Here's 69 new gameplay details we spotted during our time with GTA 6 .
Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

news.title: 《绝地潜兵2》CEO：《GTA6》没登PC是好事儿 给了我们喘息空间
news.summary: 整个游戏行业都在为《GTA6》11月发售做准备，唯恐避之不及。然而，《绝地潜兵2》的开发商箭头工作室对却对Rockstar即将掀起的风暴表现得异常淡定，主要原因在于《GTA6》采取了分阶段的发售策略。箭头CEO Sham

content.v: 整个游戏行业都在为《GTA6》11月发售做准备，唯恐避之不及。然而，《绝地潜兵2》的开发商箭头工作室对却对Rockstar即将掀起的风暴表现得异常淡定，主要原因在于《GTA6》采取了分阶段的发售策略。
箭头CEO Shams Jorjani在一份声明中表示：“Rockstar一直在制作那些规模离谱、投入巨大的作品，而像这样的游戏能够问世，本身就是一件很棒的事。从比较自私的角度来说，我很高兴它不会第一时间登陆PC，而且线上模式也不会在发售当天推出。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787925079_654817.webp
Rockstar已经暗示，《GTA6》在首发时会更加专注于单人体验。《给他爱5》的GTA Online也没有在游戏发售当天上线，而是在几周后才推出。
无论如何，这些因素都给《绝地潜兵2》争取到了一些喘息空间。毕竟，他的游戏讲的是玩家在无休止的太空战争中消灭虫群、拆解半机械人的故事。
“这意味着《绝地潜兵2》可以继续在属于我们自己的空间里大杀四方，也正因为如此，《GTA6》不会变成所有人都担心的那个吞噬一切的庞然大物。”
这一点确实很关键。虽然所有人都在等待下一部《GTA》席卷流行文化，但《GTA6》首发时只登陆PS5和Xbox Series X。只玩PC的玩家还得继续等待，而那些更关注线上内容的玩家，恐怕也得在这里继续坐着等上一段不确定的时间。
不过，这并不会影响广告和新闻报道——至少在圣诞节前，你都能看到关于《GTA6》的新闻头条。Shams Jorjani也承认，这一切对Rockstar来说并不罕见，他们只是在做几十年来一直在做的事情。
他说：“目前业内所有公司都在不断调整策略，过度关注早期玩家反馈，只为生存下去。但Rockstar拥有强大的品牌影响力，可以自信地按部就班地走他们经典的路线。”
从《GTA3》开始，R星就一直处在这样的地位。这些游戏的发售本身就是一种行业事件，而且随着时间推移，它们已经成为越来越难以应对的竞争对手。Jorjani认为，这一次《GTA6》又会重新抬高行业标准。
“他们有足够的信心和自由，用十年的时间按照老派的方式打造游戏，因为他们知道核心游戏体验一定能够交出满意的答卷。这款游戏肯定会再次把行业标准拉高。”

news.title: Pulsar 的新鼠标被切成两半，使其真正“疯狂轻”
news.summary: 'I swear it came like that,' I say as I chew through half a mouse.

content.v: With mice sensors getting so ludicrously high-spec'd, some competitive gaming mouse brands are instead trying to make the shell as light as possible. Lighter = speedier. And Pulsar is finally joining the uber-lightweight mouse trend, with a 29 gram gaming mouse that is, well, half of a mouse.

Effectively, the new X2F CrazyLight is just the front half of a gaming mouse, including the sensors, switches, and battery. Pulsar is not the first to cut a gaming mouse in half (in fact, the G-Wolves HSK Pro V2.0 has been around for a while and is just 26.8 g).

It's not even the first very light gaming mouse from Pulsar, with the X2 CrazyLight Mini being 35 g, but it is the lightest ever Pulsar mouse, to my knowledge. And it manages to get that weight without going for the honeycomb shell that many other lightweight competitors go for.

According to Pulsar , the new X2F comes kitted with Pulsar's new SX2 sensor, which we don't currently have the stats for. The previous generation XS1 has a DPI of up to 32,000, a max speed of 750 IPS, and acceleration of 50 G. This is the sensor our Jacob Fox had his mitts on when he reviewed the X2 CrazyLight Medium and X3 Crazylight Mini . It also supports up to 8,000 Hz polling. I would assume the XS2 ups some of those stats.

For context, the Razer Viper V4 Pro , which we consider to be the best gaming mouse right now, has Razer's latest Focus Pro sensor and offers 50,000 DPI, with a max speed of 930 IPS, and acceleration of 90 G.
Pulsar LAB : X2F CrazylightSensor: XS2MCU: Nordic 54L15Switch: Pulsar OpticalEncoder: TTC GoldBattery: 210mAWeight: 29gSEPT 28th, 2026 pic.twitter.com/9MlWzFuLKz August 28, 2026

Alternatively, we think the Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike is the best competitive mouse right now, and its Hero 2 sensor offers a DPI of 44,000, a max speed of 888 IPS, and a max acceleration of 88 G.

Whether or not the X2F CrazyLight will be the best competitive mouse after its release on September 28 will likely be a combination of how good the sensor is, how well balanced the weight is, and, of course, its price. Unfortunately, we don't have information on any of those yet. Also, even within the competitive mouse scene, it's sure to be pretty niche, since you have to use a fully fingertipped grip to use these kinds of mice.

We haven't got hands-on, so it's hard to say much more, but the only critique I could levy from looks (other than 'where's the rest of the mouse?') is that you can already see the 210 mA battery, so it's a shame it's not hot swappable. A hot-swappable battery could allow for a smaller battery in the device itself, further reducing the weight, and it's just a great way of staying charged at all times. Though that would presumably add on extra weight, which might defeat the purpose for this kind of mouse.

The notion of chopping off half of your gaming mouse to improve speed definitely feels a bit niche to me, but the fact that multiple companies are doing it implies there are many more competitively minded people than I otherwise thought. Let's just hope they aren't in my games. I prefer the easy opponents I'm currently being put up against.

news.title: id Software 的前共同所有者表示，他们绝对会在当时使用 gen AI：“约翰·卡马克就像制作天网之类的东西”
news.summary: "I make this joke that someone needs to come up with the 'Half-Life 2 of AI'."

content.v: Generative AI is a hot-button topic in the industry, and for good reason—it's been kinda destructive, whether that's jacking up hardware prices or putting people out of a job —and while there have been some fairly mundane use cases that seem helpful, it's been hard to escape the sheer sense of mania that's built around its use. Or the bad PR, juiced out of the sheer exhaustion we've all had from executives promising the matrix or something .

So, naturally, it came up in a conversation with Tim Willits, the CCO of Saber Interactive and also the co-owner id Software from 1995-2019. Speaking to PC Gamer's own Joshua Wolens at Gamescom 2026 , he notes that: "As most people know, we are experimenting with AI in future games. We don't have it here right now, but we announced [Rideshare Simulator] and I want to clarify things because there's some misconceptions."

If you're wondering why we're talking about a Rideshare sim, here's some context: Saber landed in hot water earlier this month over it, because it seemingly delayed its AI disclosures on Steam for a while , and was exposed as using AI by a former writer who claims they were booted off the team in favour of it.

That same writer was badmouthed by Saber's CEO Matthew Karch, who later apologised . Willits says that Rideshare's main campaign mode and all of its side missions are written by humans, and the AI components are only used for an optional game mode called Free Ride: "We're going to use AI for the passengers, so we can deliver new stories.

"So that is only possible if we use AI for that—this is an experiment. We at Saber want to figure out how we can use this technology, so we're doing it at a small scale to try to learn. We're like everyone else, we're just trying to figure this out. But there is no generative AI in our big titles. No Hellraiser, no Turok, none in Stuntman."

I feel like an asterisk has to hang over that "only possible"—while, yes, churning an infinite stream of dialogue for an optional mode is only possible with generative AI, a free ride mode with enough conversations for it to not grow stale absolutely could've been cobbled together with actual writers and voice actors. Sure, you'd run out eventually, but I don't think anyone's hungry to make Rideshare Simulator their forever game.

Still, Willits emphasises: "We want to experiment, and I do believe that there will be a company—I don't know who—but some game development company will create a game that uses AI in such an amazing way that everyone will be like, 'That's it, that's what we need to do'." He then goes on to joke "that someone needs to come up with the 'Half Life 2 of AI', something that's so amazing that it just launches some type of killer app."

I remain characteristically unconvinced, though in fairness to Willits, I do at least think that—if generative AI does find a use as the core of a videogame—it'll probably be a new genre of its own, rather than trying to create an infinite RPG with infinite NPCs. An act which would just shake out to make something unappealing and meaningless .

The thing that makes me cynical is we keep watching money being burned and datacenters being built precisely because the tech doesn't really seem all that useful for anything other than busywork . When it takes centre-stage, it produces voice acting that's bland , writing that's terrible , and art devoid of direction or memorability , even as it gets more technically proficient.

I'll eat my artificially-generated hat with a side of humble pie if Willits' "Half-Life 2 of AI" game materialises, but a lot of people have swung at that ball and missed, and each time I feel like the bat is a little smaller. Still, Willits says that id Software probably would've used generative AI if it was a thing back in the day—because the studio was always at the cutting edge.

"Yes! Oh, of course. I mean, look at what [id Software] has done. In 1999, when we released Quake 3, it required a graphics card, and we got so much hate for that. People said we were going to ruin the industry. Nobody was going to spend $100 on a video card, and it was the dumbest thing that anyone ever did … I know for sure back in the day if it was available, John Carmack would be like making Skynet or something."

Still, to be fair to Willits, he seems to share my view that the game'll have to prove that generative AI can change the industry itself, rather than via the promises of a CEO somewhere: "The games will speak for themselves, even in our experiment with Rideshare, I encourage people to check it out when it comes out, play it themselves. They may be like 'oh, this is cool! I like this'. And if they don't like it? Fine. And but the games speak for themselves."

news.title: 国产《湮灭之潮》科隆拿奖 击败一众国际IP
news.summary: 8月28日，由日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）研发并发行的国产单机动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，在 2026 科隆游戏展大奖（gamesc…

content.v: 8月28日，由日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）研发并发行的国产单机动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，在 2026 科隆游戏展大奖（gamescom award 2026）颁奖典礼上正式摘得「最具史诗感」（The Most Epic Game）大奖。这款出自成都团队的处女作，力压《红色沙漠》（Crimson Desert）、《战锤40K》（Warhammer 40K）等国际 IP 胜出。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282148544410.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281847317468.jpg
力压国际大作，成都团队首作扬威科隆
gamescom award 由德国数字游戏文化基金会主办，是全球最大游戏盛会科隆游戏展的官方奖项。值得关注的是，「最具史诗感」大奖的往届得主中不乏全球顶级 IP：《塞尔达传说》《怪物猎人：荒野》《生化危机：安魂曲》均曾摘得此桂冠，《湮灭之潮》此番能从中突围，含金量不言而喻。
继全新宣传片「旧日之纱」于开幕夜直播（Opening Night Live）首映、并于科隆展览中心 6 号馆 B-050 展位迎来公开试玩之后，本作凭借酣畅淋漓的战斗体验、电影级的演出品质、独特的幻影骑士系统与史诗级 Boss 战，征服了到场媒体与玩家。将亚瑟王传奇融入「异世界入侵下的破碎伦敦」的独特设定，正是这一殊荣的最佳注脚。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281847437281.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281850213359.png
从格雯德琳的情感旅程，到召唤圆桌骑士对抗半神
“科隆游戏展是行业内最具影响力的展会之一。我们能在这里获得『最具史诗感』大奖，感到非常荣幸。”《湮灭之潮》游戏监制陈琦表示，“从开发之初，我们的目标就是以中国团队的视角，改编亚瑟王经典。这座奖杯，是对我们开发团队辛勤付出、创造力与热情的极大肯定。在众多优秀的提名作品能最终胜出，我们倍感鼓舞，不胜感激。”
自《黑神话：悟空》之后，《湮灭之潮》成为又一款在科隆游戏展斩获大奖的国产单机游戏。从成都东郊记忆的千人试玩会，到德国科隆 gamescom 的领奖台，《湮灭之潮》正将它的瑰奇幻想带向更广阔的世界。

news.title: 曝布鲁斯威利斯家人考虑捐献其大脑 饱受痴呆症困扰
news.summary: 据外媒Indulge Express报道，71岁布鲁斯·威利斯的家人据称已经开始为他未来的告别事宜做准备，并考虑在其去世后将其大脑捐献给科学…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282140095989.png
据外媒Indulge Express报道，71岁布鲁斯·威利斯的家人据称已经开始为他未来的告别事宜做准备，并考虑在其去世后将其大脑捐献给科学研究机构，用于额颞叶痴呆（FTD）相关研究。
不过，目前这一消息尚未得到布鲁斯·威利斯家人的官方证实。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282140312989.png
报道称，布鲁斯·威利斯近年来一直受到健康问题困扰。研究人员认为，遗体大脑捐献能够帮助科学界进一步了解神经退行性疾病的发病机制，并推动相关疾病的研究。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282140407486.png
2022年，布鲁斯·威利斯的家人曾公开透露，他被诊断出患有失语症。2023年，家人进一步确认其病情已经发展为额颞叶痴呆。这种疾病可能影响患者的语言交流、行为以及认知能力。此后，布鲁斯·威利斯逐渐退出影视行业。

news.title: 变聪明了！《GTA6》NPC发现玩家公开携带武器后会报警
news.summary: 在《GTA》系列中，玩家过去一直可以全副武装地走在街头，而不用担心引起游戏中NPC的注意。不过，《GTA6》里的NPC将会比前作更加敏锐，这也意味着在公共场合携带武器将要付出代价。根据《纽约时报》对《GTA 6》的预览报

content.v: 在《GTA》系列中，玩家过去一直可以全副武装地走在街头，而不用担心引起游戏中NPC的注意。不过，《GTA6》里的NPC将会比前作更加敏锐，这也意味着在公共场合携带武器将要付出代价。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787923990_758668.webp
根据《纽约时报》对《GTA 6》的预览报道：“在这款游戏中，玩家不能再掏出一把霰弹枪或火箭筒，然后若无其事地走在街上，还指望NPC不会报警。”
《GTA6》将恢复系列经典的六星通缉等级。相比单纯携带火箭筒，玩家开火后显然会惹上更大的麻烦。不过，让NPC面对潜在威胁时表现得更加真实，也为游戏玩法增加了一个玩家今后必须考虑的新因素。
虽然游戏男主角之一杰森的配音表现似乎受到了不少负面评价，但玩家们对《GTA6》的其他方面给予了好评，包括可以与狗互动，以及杰森与另一位主角露西亚之间可能存在的复杂感情故事。
《GTA6》将于11月19日发售，登陆PS5和Xbox Series X|S平台。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: 《上古卷轴》《暗黑破坏神》影视化在望？微软正洽谈十多款游戏改编
news.summary: Xbox似乎准备全面押注游戏改编项目，正向流媒体平台和影视制作公司推介旗下多款游戏。据Puck报道，微软和Xbox一直在就一揽子包含“十多款游戏”的改编项目进行洽谈。该媒体点名提到的作品包括《光环》（再次改编）、《上古卷

content.v: Xbox似乎准备全面押注游戏改编项目，正向流媒体平台和影视制作公司推介旗下多款游戏。据Puck报道，微软和Xbox一直在就一揽子包含“十多款游戏”的改编项目进行洽谈。
该媒体点名提到的作品包括《光环》（再次改编）、《上古卷轴》、《魔兽世界》和《暗黑破坏神》。据报道，Netflix、派拉蒙和环球影业都已经与微软进行过接洽，而微软似乎希望这笔潜在交易的报价能够达到约3亿美元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787923297_390226.webp
Xbox在影视改编领域的表现可谓喜忧参半
亚马逊Prime Video推出的《辐射》系列，取得了巨大成功;《我的世界》电影则在全球票房上突破了10亿美元，目前续集也已经在筹备中。
相比之下，真人版《光环》仅播出两季便被取消，而且该剧对于士官长和星盟的塑造也饱受批评。其他项目，例如《战争机器》Netflix剧集，则已经搁置多年，迟迟没有进展。
Xbox希望将更多旗下IP搬上荧幕，也是当前好莱坞掀起的游戏影视改编热潮的一部分。
《刺猬索尼克4》即将上映，此前该系列已经在过去十年里推出了三部广受好评的电影。《战神》也将登陆Prime Video，不过该剧在拍摄期间发生了主演瑞恩·赫斯特受伤的情况，剧组不得不让戴夫·巴蒂斯塔接替他的角色。
除此之外，还有全新的《古墓丽影》剧集、《塞尔达传说》电影、《艾尔登法环》电影，以及《只狼》动画正在推进。
如今，游戏改编已经远远摆脱了过去的“魔咒”，整个领域正处于蓬勃发展的阶段。未来几年，Xbox能否继续为这股热潮添砖加瓦? 至少我们肯定不会拒绝一部《上古卷轴》真人剧集。
